frames.visible_job: Draws one connected rounded housing and short tapered nozzle facing left.
frames.instruction: Draw one long rounded housing across the upper half of the page, then taper its left end into one short open nozzle. Keep the lower middle edge clear for the handle and leave open paper at the right end for the intake.

frames.visible_job: Adds one slanted handle beneath the housing and one round rear intake.
frames.instruction: Attach one slightly forward-slanting handle beneath the housing, widening it gently toward the base. Close the right end of the housing with one large round intake and keep its center blank for later vent slots.

frames.step_name: Cut the vents and nozzle ring
frames.visible_job: Adds one nozzle ring and exactly six short radial intake slots.
frames.instruction: Wrap one narrow ring around the left nozzle opening. Inside the round rear intake, place exactly six short slots radiating from the center while keeping an even paper gap between neighbors.

frames.visible_job: Adds two handle controls plus one attached curling cord and simple plug.
frames.instruction: Place exactly two small controls down the handle front. From the handle base, pull one cord downward into a single loose curl and finish it with one simple two-prong plug, keeping the cord behind the dryer silhouette.

frames.visible_job: Adds three airflow swooshes, two highlight gaps, and one broken ground shadow.
frames.instruction: Sweep exactly three separate curved airflow lines from the nozzle toward the left. Reserve exactly two small open-paper highlights on the housing, then place one broad broken shadow beneath the dryer without touching the cord.

final_step.visible_job: Fills the established dryer, handle, hardware, airflow, cord, and shadow with bold directional marker strokes.
final_step.instruction: Fill the established housing coral, the handle and nozzle ring teal, the intake and two controls warm yellow, and the cord, plug, airflow, and broken shadow deep navy. Leave both highlights open, strengthen existing black contours, and add no new shapes.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop contains only one bold connected housing and short left-facing nozzle at their final scale. The intentional lower gap clearly reserves the handle, and the open rear end reserves the intake without asking the learner to erase a keeper line.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: I compared all six saved square crops pairwise at readable size. The housing, handle attachments, round intake, six slots, nozzle ring, two controls, cord curl, plug, three airflow marks, two highlight gaps, and broken shadow keep their positions; the final only fills established shapes with marker color.
